package postgres

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestMigration023AddsImmutableSessionEvidenceAndMandatoryDrain(t *testing.T) {
	root := migration019RepositoryRoot(t)
	up, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db/migrations/023_teacher_onboarding_session_contract.up.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	down, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "db/migrations/023_teacher_onboarding_session_contract.down.sql"))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	for _, required := range []string{
		"BEGIN;", "COMMIT;", "LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;",
		"session_schema_version SMALLINT", "session_schema_version IN (1, 2, 3)",
		"state IN ('active', 'reserved', 'handoff_pending')", "coordinator_mode IN ('onboarding_action', 'onboarding_text')",
		"status IN ('queued', 'processing', 'delivery_pending')",
		"stage IN ('received', 'interaction_reserved', 'ai_staged', 'student_staged', 'response_staged', 'delivery_pending')",
		"status IN ('claimed', 'applied')",
		"new teacher onboarding interaction requires session schema version 1..3",
		"teacher onboarding session schema version is immutable",
		"trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_session_schema_version",
		"CREATE TABLE teacher_onboarding_terminal_session", "terminal_kind = 'ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS'",
		"trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete", "trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_truncate",
		"teacher onboarding terminal session evidence cannot be deleted",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, string(up), required)
	}
	require.NotContains(t, strings.ToLower(string(up)), "update teacher_onboarding_interaction set session_schema_version", "old rows are never guessed/backfilled")
	drain := strings.SplitN(string(up), "ALTER TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction", 2)[0]
	require.NotContains(t, strings.ToUpper(drain), " JOIN ", "each drain invariant is probed independently, including NULL-linked turns and jobs without turns")
	for _, required := range []string{
		"LOCK TABLE teacher_onboarding_interaction IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;",
		"WHERE session_schema_version IS NOT NULL",
		"stamped onboarding session evidence is retained permanently",
		"DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_session_schema_version",
		"terminal onboarding session evidence is retained permanently",
		"DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete",
		"DROP TRIGGER trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_truncate",
	} {
		require.Contains(t, string(down), required)
	}
}

func TestTerminalSessionCausalIdentityExcludesRepositoryTimestamp(t *testing.T) {
	left := domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalSession{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		PersonalTeacherID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", DialogID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		SessionSchemaVersion: 3, StateRef: domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4},
		TerminalKind: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3ActivePathExists, TerminalMessageCommandID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalMessagePending, CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 8, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}
	right := left
	right.CreatedAt = left.CreatedAt.Add(time.Second)
	require.True(t, sameTeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionIdentity(left, right))
	right.StateRef.Version++
	require.False(t, sameTeacherOnboardingTerminalSessionIdentity(left, right))
}

func TestStartupAndReadinessProbeEveryMigration023Guard(t *testing.T) {
	mainFile, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(migration019RepositoryRoot(t), "cmd", "ms-go-teacher-agent", "main.go"))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	for _, trigger := range []string{
		"trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_session_schema_version",
		"trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session",
		"trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_delete",
		"trg_protect_teacher_onboarding_terminal_session_truncate",
	} {
		require.GreaterOrEqual(t, strings.Count(string(mainFile), trigger), 2, trigger+" must be checked at startup and readiness")
	}
	require.NotContains(t, string(mainFile), "'teacher_onboarding_terminal_session'::regclass", "a missing migration must report not-ready instead of making the probe itself fail")
}
